blocks.text: Let's look at this one. Select all the numbers that are solutions of x is greater than three.
blocks.display: Select all the numbers that are solutions of x > 3.

blocks.text: Three. No: three is not greater than three, so the circle at three is open.
Four. Yes: four is greater than three.
Ten. Yes: ten is greater than three.
Negative four. No: negative four is less than three, on the wrong side of the circle.
One hundred. Yes: one hundred is greater than three.
Four, ten, and one hundred are solutions. Three is not, because the circle at three is open, and negative four is on the wrong side.
